name: The Ash Coalition
description: A loose, desperate alliance of survivors from the Ashaani Red Desert, disgraced Pereshi fire-keepers, and escaped Sidhi slaves. They have no permanent home; they move with the ash-winds, trading in medicines, forbidden knowledge, and the only thing that keeps them alive: silence. They are the ones who have seen what the Veil hides, and they remember the names that were erased.
location: Ashaani borderlands, the Pereshi foothills, and the Fhara caravan routes
leverage: Disguise as traders, safe routes through the Red Desert, access to Ashaani spirit-binders and Pereshi fire-wisdom, and the location of hidden oases.
debtTrigger: When Obligation fills, the Coalition demands a 'name'—a true name of a Veiled Sister, a slaver, or a Black Hand captain. They will use it to tear the Veil a little further. If you cannot provide one, they will take yours.
quirk: Every member carries a small piece of green glass—a fragment of the Red Desert's curse—set in a leather pouch. When the glass warms, the Veil is near.
keyNPCs: Rashmi (a Veiled Sister who left the faith and now teaches others how to see through the Veil)
Bast the Tongueless (a Sidhi captain who lost his voice to a slaver's brand—he writes in a script that only the Coalition can read)
The Ember (a Pereshi fire-keeper who has not slept in nine years; he dreams of a blue flame that burns without fuel)
hooks: An Ashaani slave caravan is moving through the foothills with a cargo that is not human—it is a fragment of the Kalrantha amulet. The Coalition wants to intercept it.
A Pereshi fire-temple has been seized by the Veiled Sisters. The Coalition needs someone to retrieve a single scroll before the temple is razed.
The Hollow is pursuing a Coalition member. They have seen a face in the Red Desert that speaks with a voice that is not their own.
